title: Quick Accent causes sticking keys in Git GUI application

judgment.rationale: Multiple reporters supply affected WSLg applications and typing symptoms, but no specific swallowed or repeated event has been confirmed on current code.
evidence: The 0.77 report describes missed or repeated keys in WSLg git gui with Quick Accent; a later commenter reports similar char+space behavior across several WSLg editors on 0.86.
The reports do not establish that all editors share the same cause.

Quick Accent initializes a native keyboard listener and dispatches toolbar/input events in https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/src/modules/PowerAccent/PowerAccent.Core/PowerAccent.cs.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce WSLg typing with Quick Accent

fix_assessment.rationale: Multiple reporters supply affected WSLg applications and typing symptoms, but no specific swallowed or repeated event has been confirmed on current code.

proposed_fixes.title: Prevent Quick Accent input loss in WSLg applications
proposed_fixes.root_cause: An input suppression or replay interaction with WSLg may produce missing or repeated key events, but the event sequence has not been traced.
plan: Reproduce ordinary character-plus-space typing in WSLg git gui and one other reported editor with Quick Accent on and off.
Compare key down/up, repeat and injected events around the activation threshold without assuming a shared cause.
Fix the verified hook state or replay defect and add a regression for normal typing and intentional accent activation.
verification: Ordinary WSLg typing produces exactly the intended characters with Quick Accent enabled; accent activation still works.
